title: anthyllis vulneraria var. font-queri
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. font-queri, commonly known as Knapweed or Earth treacle, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Knapweed include its ability to act as an astringent, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Knapweed include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
